title: Cavity Barriers – Siderise
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

location.areaHint: e.g. Elevation N, L05 slab edge

questions.q: Barrier labelled Siderise, the right type for the location (horizontal/vertical), undamaged?
In position, tight to both faces of the cavity, no gaps at joints?
Fixing brackets impaled at even centres, with end brackets within 300 mm of each end?
Are joints butted and sealed, with no gaps at junctions or around brackets and services?
Fixings steel (no plastic plugs or clips)?
Barrier labelled, with photos taken before it is covered?
